admission.justification: The public observation and transition boundaries together prevent an installation or status read from unexpectedly replacing a running host; focused tests demonstrate the exact mismatch and preserved-file behavior.

applicability: Install and explicit terminal provision when an owned running host uses an earlier product Node.
conditions: Install defers before Node or home writes.
Only a successful explicit provision restart reports the earlier sibling Node folder as unused by this host.
exclusions: No deletion of old Node files or claim that another process no longer uses them.
No automatic transition through dashboard start or status.

evidence: notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L107-worker-c1ec121b-f3da-4e9e-ae4a-36795d5b9d81/freeze2/focused-tests-post-sync-final.log; exact test verifies deferral, restart, retained marker and no-change repeat

statement: An install defers a live-host Node transition and explicit provision restarts on the contract Node, reports the observed earlier product Node folder as no longer used by that host, and preserves its files.
